raw_output: When you use YouVersion websites, we collect information about the sites you visit. We also gather details like your proxy server, operating system, web browser, device ID, and your ISP or mobile carrier. We receive data from your devices and networks, including your IP address. We also use your mobile device's Wi-Fi permissions to know if you are on Wi-Fi or cellular data. This helps us give you a better experience, such as showing higher quality media on fast Wi-Fi. Wi-Fi permissions are also used for casting content to devices like Chromecast. YouVersion does not store or share this Wi-Fi information.
